name: European Union: Erasmus+ Mobility Project for Higher Education Teachers and Staff
summary: The Erasmus+ individual mobility project is not only aimed at students but also at university teachers and members of staff at higher education institutions in Germany and other European states. The programme is intended to sponsor mobility
